title: OpenEnigma M02 right rocker frame and pivot parts

snapshots.caption: The bed is raised and the toolhead is in the startup sequence. Model deposition is not visible yet.
The toolhead is depositing the first layer. Two small PETG footprints are visible at the back, and a loose strand is visible near the front-right edge.
After the printer reported completion, the toolhead was parked and all four parts were still on the bed with supports and brims. A loose strand is visible in one frame opening.

source.evidence: Normal main staging and exact archive and toolpath audit. The printer copy matched the reviewed file byte for byte. The printer then accepted the exact file and plate.

notes: Four parts for the right rocker and pivot fit trial. The slice uses same-material PETG supports, a 0.20 mm first layer and an 8 mm brim. Physical fit and cleanup await inspection. The printer reported FINISH at 187 of 187 layers with no error. Elapsed time is from observed acceptance to the first recorded FINISH state.
